fields.title: 9. Three data points to check directly before the next issue (monthly 2026-11, 11/01)
fields.md:
1. **Later part of the DA 26-1078 full text and the ICFS filing record** — After Condition 17 (deposit filing 11/4, acceptance 11/5), whether SpaceX accepted or objected. If SpaceX rejects the conditional grant, the A-2028-1 timeline changes ([DA 26-1078](https://docs.fcc.gov/public/attachments/DA-26-1078A1.txt) · FCC ICFS S00735).
2. **Result of the FCC 10/29 open meeting** — Vote on the proposal to open about 500MHz of additional D2D spectrum and the proposal to auction 2020–2025MHz. If the 2020–2025MHz upgrade that SpaceX had put on hold goes to auction, that becomes the conclusion of the held item in DA 26-1078 ([advanced-television 10/28](https://www.advanced-television.com/2026/10/28/fcc-oks-amazon-leos-globalstar-acquisition/)).
3. **Keep the T4·T7 check items** — Results of Ariane 64 LE-04 (11/23) and Vulcan LV-01 (November), the leo.amazon.com pricing posting, and the Department of Defense investigation report (11/19) ([EDGAR 8-K list](https://www.sec.gov/cgi-bin/browse-edgar?action=getcompany&CIK=0001181412&type=8-K&dateb=&owner=include&count=10) · `data/spacex_watch.json launches.competitor_next`).
